ck: (15)kasitinanacarya atyanunane paksan pariskartunasankate — nanviti anavacineti yatyapi yavatvisesananavacinasya potayitunasakyatvana paksatvasanpava sitante paksaprasitisca tatapyanavacinapatasyantakaranatyanavacinaparataya tatanavacinatvena paksatve tatparyana tosa pahucivapaksentakaraneneti, ekacivapaksecnaneneti avacinan visistan tasya ca nityatvanaparanartikatvan, vyavaharikatvaniti yavat tataca tatsatasananasatakapetasya sitatvat sitasatanan, paranartikapetasiterartantaran cetyasaya atra visistakatakavisesyansasyEva paksatvanankikrtya sanatasyan uktasitasatanatyapavasputikaranaya prcati – kastarhi taveti avacinaniti sananye napunsakan avacinan cEtanyaniti va nitya syatiti sasasrnkativatasati syatityarta civasya nityatvenacnanavat pravilinasya prahnapavayokatiti pava tataca nisprayocanatvena vetantanananaranpaniyatvaprasanka iti tyeyan civa saptartavisistakatakavisesyansasya prahnatvapatireva civanuktisaptarta tatra ca noktatosa ityasankate — nanviti civapavopalaksitacEtanyasya paksatvanartantaratityasayena sanatate – yatreti santostavyanityanenapyupetyEvetanuktan vastuto visistasyapi satyatvaneveti sucitan tateveti tukanusantatrtvasya civapavaniyatatvatiti pava nanvaparanartikatukanusantatrtvasya prahnanyanEkantyat paranartikatvena heturvisesaniya tataca paranate hetvasitirityasankate — tukanusantatrtvaniti syatevan yati paranartikatvena heturvisesita syana cEvan, pratipasikanEkantyasyatosatvat anyatanunananatrocetapateriti pavenaha — kinaneneti anavasaratantavayitenanenanuktopalanpena kinasnakananistan ? na kinapityarta atayan purvapaksapipraya tukanusantatrtvasya nityatvana paksatarnatvan satyanrtayo sanpantanupapate yatyapyatyastatistanapavarupa sanpantosti tatapi nasO hetutvaniyanaka sitante tukanusantatrtvasyanaropitatvena tatanupapate kintvasrayasrayipava tataca paresanasitiriti atra pruna anusantatrtvasanpantena tukavatvasyEvatra hetutvan anusantatrtvan ca paranate svatistana eva, sitante ca svatara eva tukatervrtiniyanakaniti na kopi tosa katan paksatrstantapava iti yatyapi prakrte vativipratipatya petasya santiktatvana santiktasatyakatvatilaksanapaksatvanupapatirasti tatapi paksatvasahitatrstantatvanupapatervivaksitatvana tosa yatva , petasite purvanapetaniscaye yata civasya paksatvananupapanan tata tatsantehe prahnano trstantatvananupapananityarte tatparyan ata eva petasite purvanityapi sankacate anyata petasityutaranapi paksatvanupapatisatvena tatasankate atra cive prahnapetasantehepi prahnani tatapetaniscayanoktatosa na capete tatanupapat
